keySentence: A true princess is kind even when life is not kind to her.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Sara's life changed completely after her father died so suddenly. She had to clean floors and carry heavy coal buckets every morning. Miss Minchin gave her the hardest jobs and the smallest meals daily. Lavinia and the wealthy students laughed at Sara's worn out dress. But Sara never said a cruel word back to any of them ever. She helped Becky the servant girl even when she was tired and hungry. She knew that how we treat others defines who we really are inside. A true princess is kind even when life is not kind to her.
facts.Word cards: princess = 공주 / still = 여전히 / rags = 누더기 / wealth = 부, 재산
